privacy: No cookies, no login, no cross-site identifiers. A random session id lives in sessionStorage only. IP addresses are never sent by the client. If an analytics endpoint is configured, only the fields listed per event are transmitted; if none is configured, events stay in the browser's local queue and are never transmitted.
endpoint_note: See suggestions.html S-04 for provisioning options. Endpoint contract is documented in tools/analytics-endpoint.md.

events.name: page_view
events.definition: A page finished loading in a foreground tab.

events.name: product_impression
events.definition: A product card or product table row was at least 50% visible for 1 second.
events.emitted_by: IntersectionObserver on .product-card and table.data tbody rows

events.name: outbound_click
events.definition: A click on a rel=sponsored product link leaving for Amazon.
events.emitted_by: click handler on a[rel~=sponsored]; this is the outbound-click counter
events.note: The destination URL is reduced to its ASIN; query strings are never transmitted.

events.name: guide_read
events.definition: A guide article was scrolled to at least 75% of its height.
events.emitted_by: scroll handler on .article pages, once per session per article

events.name: chooser_result
events.definition: A visitor completed the three-question chooser on comparison.html and a verdict was rendered.
events.note: answers is an array of three short strings (counter depth, style, cooking frequency); no free text.
